[[File:Anaxes_Citadel.jpg|thumb|Layout of the Anaxes Citadel.]]
The '''Anaxes Citadel''' was a massive complex of training schools, research labs, intelligence centers, offices, archives, and parade grounds on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. It served as the primary governmental building for the planet.

==History==
Built during the time of the [[Azure Imperium]], it allowed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] to station its largest defensive force in the [[Axum system|Solis Axum System]], and also housed the [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|Republic Navy War College]]. Roughly a third the size of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], the Anaxes Citadel was nevertheless more impressive to most naval officers, for it was here on the Azure Walk that the Navy's highest honors were bestowed.<ref name="CATCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

The terraced hills above the Citadel were dotted with estates held by families that may not have been Old [[Anaxsi]], but whose names were also synonymous with naval service.<ref name="CATCW" />

Until the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Citadel answered to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
==Legacy==
Throughout galactic history, perhaps even since the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Period]] to the [[New republic era]], the Citadel was always considered the pinnacle of naval culture. It was featured in many stock [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]] that featured a military character as a protagonist; the formulaic plot would eventually place the brave hero awarded in the [[Grand Piazza]].<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
